Generated HTTP static file tables for stable, alpha, and dev GUI assets.

# Purpose
This C file defines embedded static content for the GUI HTTP server. It is generated by `make frontend` and must not be edited by hand. The file uses `FD_IMPORT_BINARY` to import each built frontend asset into the program as binary data, including SVG images, JavaScript files, CSS files, font files, `index.html`, and `LICENSE_DEPENDENCIES`. For each asset, the file also imports `zstd` and `gzip` compressed forms so the server can serve compressed content when needed.

The file then builds three `fd_http_static_file_t` tables: `STATIC_FILES_STABLE`, `STATIC_FILES_ALPHA`, and `STATIC_FILES_DEV`. Each table maps a URL path such as `/index.html` or `/assets/...` to the imported binary data and its compressed variants. These tables provide the static file sets for the stable, alpha, and dev frontend builds, and they form the external interface used by the HTTP layer to serve the GUI assets.
